criteria.description: [R1] `from app_int.main import round_currency` succeeds and `round_currency` is callable.
[R2] For every input in these criteria, Decimal(str(round_currency(x))) has at most 2 digits after the decimal point. Results are compared by their decimal value, as Decimal(str(result)).
[R3] round_currency(Decimal('2.345')) equals Decimal('2.35'), and round_currency(Decimal('2.335')) equals Decimal('2.34') (round-half-up, not banker's rounding).
[R4] round_currency(Decimal('-2.345')) equals Decimal('-2.35'), and round_currency(-2.345) (float) equals Decimal('-2.35').
[R5] round_currency(2.344) equals Decimal('2.34'), round_currency(2.346) equals Decimal('2.35'), and round_currency(-2.344) equals Decimal('-2.34').

[R6] With float inputs: round_currency(2.345) equals Decimal('2.35'), round_currency(1.005) equals Decimal('1.01'), round_currency(0.125) equals Decimal('0.13'), and round_currency(2.675) equals Decimal('2.68').
[R7] round_currency(2.3) equals Decimal('2.30'), round_currency(5) equals Decimal('5.00'), round_currency(0) equals Decimal('0.00'), and round_currency(Decimal('19.99')) equals Decimal('19.99').
[R8] round_currency accepts an int (7), a float (7.005) and a decimal.Decimal (Decimal('7.005')) without raising, returning values equal to Decimal('7.00'), Decimal('7.01') and Decimal('7.01').
[R9] health_check() still returns {'status': 'ok'} and add(2, 3) still returns 5.
[R10] `uv run pytest -q` exits with status 0 and `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
[R11] round_currency.__doc__ is non-empty and contains the phrase 'half-up' (case-insensitive).
[R12] The diff adds no new entries to the runtime dependencies in pyproject.toml.
